question: What disruptive power is associated with the molten-gold radiance of the visualization?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is described as a cause of agitation of cities and the like.
Both descriptions refer to the same visualized form.
inference: The molten-gold form is the cause of agitation of cities and similar effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of the agitation of cities and the like.
